root.label: AP-NORC poll finds voters blame Trump for high prices

events.label: AP-NORC poll finds voters blame Trump for high prices

slots.name: high prices blame
slots.sentence: The Associated Press/NORC Research Center poll released Thursday found that 65 percent of Americans blame President Trump’s policies for high prices more than any other economic driver, including the war.

slots.name: economy disapproval
slots.sentence: Seventy-three percent disapprove of his handle on the economy, with 69 percent saying Trump’s economic agenda is “worse than expected.”
